description: This Java source file defines the DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint class, which implements an HTTP endpoint for managing device registration in the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides route handling for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting devices via HTTP methods, integrating with Vert.x for HTTP server operations and event bus message passing.

classes.name: DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHttpEndpoint to provide HTTP routes for device management operations, including create, read, update, and delete, by handling HTTP requests and forwarding messages via Vert.x event bus.

methods.name: DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance, enabling it to add routes and handle HTTP communication.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the event bus address used for device management messages.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, combining API version and endpoint identifier.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Configures all the HTTP routes (POST, GET, PUT, DELETE) for managing devices, assigning appropriate handlers for each route.

methods.name: doGetDevice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve device information based on tenant and device ID, responding with JSON payload.

methods.name: doCreateDevice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new device, constructing a message for the event bus and setting the Location header in response.

methods.name: doUpdateDevice
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing device information, including resource versioning.

methods.name: doDeleteDevice
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a device based on tenant and device ID.
